tagline: Down to Trail Town, then up toward Whitetop.
intro: Route 91 comes south from Glade Spring through Lodi, a village named for the Italian city, set between the highway's crossings of two forks of the Holston, and into Damascus. South of town it follows Laurel Creek through the Iron Mountains to the Tennessee line.

From Laureldale on Route 91 the byway also takes US 58 and Route 603 past Konnarock to Troutdale, while Whitetop Road branches off near Konnarock past Elk Garden and Whitetop Mountain for North Carolina.

moments.title: Damascus
moments.text: Five trails meet in Damascus, the Appalachian Trail and the Virginia Creeper Trail among them, and each May its Trail Days festival is the largest gathering of Appalachian Trail hikers anywhere.

moments.title: Konnarock
moments.text: The Lutheran girls' school built here in 1925 is sheathed in bark shingles. After it closed in 1958 the Forest Service acquired it, and it now houses a nature education center.

moments.title: Whitetop Mountain
moments.text: Virginia's second-highest independent mountain keeps old-growth red spruce more usually found far to the north, and in most years from 1932 to 1939 it hosted the White Top Folk Festival.
